person.headline: Head of Development - Offshore
person.summary: Head of Development (Offshore) at SSY. I lead a small team building maritime trading platforms while staying deeply hands-on with the day-to-day coding. Currently delivering our core offshore database and custom AI-based integrations.

employment.title: Head of Development - Offshore
highlights: Own the architecture, engineering and delivery of SSY’s next-generation Offshore broking platform, replacing legacy systems and fragmented workflows used across four offices.
Lead development of a single broker platform spanning vessel intelligence, fixtures, requirements, positions and live AIS data across a fleet dataset of approximately 20,000 vessels.
Own the full technical stack, including frontend, backend services, APIs, database design, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, production support and technical architecture.
Set product roadmap and delivery priorities directly with brokers and senior stakeholders, translating commercial workflows into software that can be released and improved rapidly.
Lead a distributed team of three developers, with responsibility for hiring, mentoring, code quality, delivery standards and performance management.

Replace spreadsheet-driven and manual broker workflows with shared, live systems that improve data visibility, reduce duplicate entry and give teams a consistent view of fixtures, vessel availability and market activity.
Design systems around direct broker feedback, consolidating previously disconnected workflows and reducing reliance on ageing software first introduced in 2015.

employment.title: Full-Stack Engineer
highlights: Developed and supported SSY Navigator, a maritime intelligence platform serving more than 1,200 internal and external users.
Delivered two mandated product rebrands under fixed compliance deadlines without service downtime.
Designed and deployed a highly available Azure-based PDF generation service, replacing a third-party dependency and reducing vendor lock-in and infrastructure cost.
Built and maintained full-stack features across internal and client-facing maritime applications, working across frontend, backend, APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure.

employment.title: Data Services Engineer
highlights: Led enterprise data migrations for more than 20 customers representing millions in annual recurring revenue, with no critical migration incidents.
Built automated migration tooling that reduced manual work and shortened delivery timelines across repeatable customer migration processes.
Engineered end-of-license data extraction workflows capable of processing datasets larger than 10 TB across AWS-backed storage and database environments.
Developed ETL pipelines, migration utilities, and validation tooling using T-SQL, Node.js, Java, .NET, and Python.
Provisioned and maintained AWS infrastructure including S3, Lambda, RDS, and EC2 using Terraform and command-line tooling.
